international.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon ‘executed’ Jesse Baird and Luke Davies then lied about it, prosecution argues
international.summary: Crown urges jury to reject accused’s claim of self-defence and find him guilty of murdering Sydney couple Beau Lamarre-Condon is a “proven and persistent liar” and the evidence in his double murder trial shows the deaths of Jesse Baird and Luke Davies could only have been an “execution”, a court has been told. Lamarre-Condon is accused of fatally shooting the Sydney couple with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024. Continue reading...
